header.name: VYSE-Vibrant Visuals
header.description: Shader-style Vibrant Visuals: a filmic picture, strong sunlight against blue shade, a deep sky with soft drifting clouds, a small sun and moon, clear air and light shafts, misty rain, clear water and coloured block light. Turn on Vibrant Visuals in Video Settings; pick the sky with the gear in the pack settings.
